notes.title: Version 4.4 maintenance patch is out now
notes.content:
Contains:

Several minor bug fixes.

Some card balancing issues fixed now that team play has been thoroughly soak tested.

We've taken a pass through the maps making about 50% of them have less useable area. (By filling in around the edges.)

Daily Challenge made easier, especially at the beginner end.

Maximum clan members raised to 10.

Added a new quest to the campaigns. It's you versus two AI's for big payouts in both coins and packs. You'll find it at the end of the book.

More detail here: http://www.rubicondev.com/blog/combat-monsters-v4-4-maintenance-patch/

Happy New Year!

notes.title: Version 3.3 now live
notes.content:
Mostly just maintenance this time:
Warrior Heroes have been buffed a little
Rune Health now starts at 15
Some other minor balancing adjustments
Online screen improved
Pre-game chat lobby now global
Various stability issues fixed
Robots mojo cost incongruities fixed

notes.title: "Reinforcements" expansion is now live. (v3.1)
notes.content:
This is a monster-sized expansion, bringing you tons more of everything. With over 1,000 unique combat monsters, the reinforcements have arrived!

[list]
[*]1,200+ new cards
[*]1,000+ monsters
[*]Lots more free stuff
[*]Important gameplay rules changes
[*]Card balancing
[*]Much improved online experience
[*]Slicker front end
[*]Improved graphics
[*]Too much more to list here
[/list]

Please see our detailed release notes [url=http://www.rubicondev.com/blog/combat-monsters-3-0-reinforcements]Here.[/url]

notes.title: Features for next update - v2.5
notes.content:
Massive long list of new features, all the fun stuff we've been wanting to get around to for ages.

As well as a ton more cards (at least 400 more, mostly monsters), there will be clans, tournaments, new game modes and etc. Full details at the link below.

http://www.rubicondev.com/blog/combat-monsters-feature-list-for-next-update-v2-5/

notes.title: It's here! v2.4 update now available
notes.content:
Tons of new stuff, tons of tweaks based on user feedback, thanks.

[h1]Highlights:[/h1]
Increased Rubicoin payouts for everything
Two new monster races
80 new cards
Card trading system
Foil cards (in game)
Keyboard controls

And much more. Full details here:
http://www.rubicondev.com/blog/combat-monsters-v2-4-update-rsn/
